statements.t: We estimate that we will incur additional employee-related and facility exit restructuring costs in 2026; however, the Company cannot estimate the total amount expected to be incurred at this time as cost reduction actions continue to be evaluated.

The Company currently anticipates completing these restructuring activities in 2026; however, the timing and scope of these actions may change, and additional actions may be taken, depending on business conditions and other factors.
We plan to fund these activities through a combination of our current cash balances and future operating cash flows.
We believe that our liquidity requirements and contractual obligations for at least the next 12 months will be adequately covered by our current cash balances and cash provided by operations.
Additionally, long-term contractual obligations are also currently expected to be funded from our current cash balances and cash from operations.
We expect operating cash flows to improve in the fourth quarter of 2026 compared to the third quarter, but if that improvement does not occur, we may need financing.

statements.t: Supported by continued positive momentum across our Outdoor and Adventure segments, we are pleased to raise our full-year guidance, reflecting our confidence in business fundamentals and constructive outlook for the remainder of 2026.”
The Company does not intend to disclose further developments regarding the review unless and until it determines that further disclosure is appropriate or required.

The Company now expects fiscal year 2026 sales to range between $251 million and $255 million and adjusted EBITDA to range between approximately $15 million and $17 million, or an adjusted EBITDA margin of 6.3% at the mid-point of the revenue and adjusted EBITDA ranges, compared to its prior outlook of sales of $245 million to $255 million and adjusted EBITDA of approximately $12 million to $13 million.

Capital expenditures are expected to remain between $6 million and $7 million, consistent with the Company’s prior outlook, and free cash flow is now expected to be break even for the full year 2026, compared to the Company’s prior outlook of $6 million.
Accordingly, the Company does not provide reconciliations of adjusted EBITDA, adjusted EBITDA margin or free cash flow guidance to their most directly comparable GAAP measures for fiscal year 2026.
The conference call will be broadcast live and available for replay on the Company’s website at www.claruscorp.com .
